properties.decision: Two repair rules had asserted a condition they never computed since 2026-08-08/10, and the fix needed two definitions nobody had been asked for. Anthony settled both on 2026-09-15 on the session's recommendation. (1) RESOLVING a contradiction: an ACCEPTED Decision that both endpoints are GOVERNED_BY. Both, because a decision touching one side has not ruled on the disagreement; accepted, because a proposed Decision is somebody thinking out loud and must not silence anything. The CONTRADICTS edge stays — the history is the point. (2) FOLLOWING THROUGH on an anticipation: the anticipated node EVOLVES_INTO anything (work was recorded against it), or has arrived on its own type's terms — a Decision accepted, a Capability or Component realized or verified, a Requirement met, an epoch arrived. A Requirement merely accepted is a need agreed, not a need met, and stays unresolved. A type with no arrival status (a TemporalFact, an Artifact) can only follow through by evolving. Both suppressions are COUNTED in the sweep under their own heading, suppressed_by_resolution, kept apart from suppressed_by_parked_idea because the two say opposite things: parked means the sweep did not look, resolved means it looked and the design had answered.
properties.name: DECIDED — a contradiction is resolved by an ACCEPTED Decision governing BOTH endpoints; an anticipation is followed through when its target EVOLVES_INTO something or has arrived on its own type's terms
properties.rationale: The counter-argument, stated and overruled: any definition converts an over-firing rule into an under-firing one, and the cheapest honest option was to leave both at their current severity and record why. Overruled because the cost of the over-firing was measured three times — a contradiction that could be acknowledged or erased but never resolved (2026-08-08, proved by execution), a design punished for recording anticipation at all (2026-08-10), and a rule that fired the moment a question was ANSWERED (2026-09-02, defects 73 -> 74 for finishing the work) — and because the definitions chosen are the narrow ones: accepted-and-both for a resolution, arrived-or-evolved for follow-through. Each is pinned from both sides in a_rule_tests_the_condition_its_message_names.rs (the case it clears and the nearest case it must not clear), so a later loosening has to change a test on the record. Closes fact:two-heal-rules-assert-a-condition-they-never-test, fact:defect-a-contradiction-cannot-be-resolved-only-acknowledged and fact:unresolved-setup-says-nothing-follows-through-and-never-checks-whether-anything-did, which were one defect recorded three times.
